ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the contraction of 'will not'? (1 mark)
   A. wil'nt
   B. willn't
   C. wont
   D. won't

2. Which phrase has adjectives in the correct order? (1 mark)
   A. a red round small ball
   B. a round small red ball
   C. a small round red ball
   D. a round red small ball

3. What is a narrative? (1 mark)
   A. A story that tells what happened in order
   B. A set of instructions
   C. A description of an object
   D. A list of facts

4. Which sentence is a run-on sentence that needs full stops? (1 mark)
   A. I went to the market I bought fish we went home.
   B. I bought fish.
   C. We went home.
   D. I went to the market.

5. An inferential question needs you to (1 mark)
   A. skip the text
   B. copy a sentence
   C. use clues and think
   D. guess without reading

6. First aid words: Which word has the sound /aɪ/? (1 mark)
   A. box
   B. bite
   C. stop
   D. hot

7. Which word has the soft buzzing sound /ʒ/ in the middle? (1 mark)
   A. jug
   B. bridge
   C. television
   D. yam

8. Which word has the gliding vowel /əʊ/? (1 mark)
   A. bit
   B. soap
   C. ship
   D. sip

9. What should you do first when you get a form? (1 mark)
   A. Sign it
   B. Start writing at once
   C. Read the instructions
   D. Fold it

10. Which word begins with the sound /j/? (1 mark)
   A. yellow
   B. jam
   C. giant
   D. zebra

11. Which is safe when filling an online form? (1 mark)
   A. Give your password to any site
   B. Share your address with strangers
   C. Fill it with a parent or teacher
   D. Fill it in secret

12. First aid is (1 mark)
   A. a road sign
   B. a kind of food
   C. the first help given to a person who is hurt or ill
   D. the last help

13. Which noun is countable? (1 mark)
   A. rice
   B. money
   C. time
   D. mango

14. Which is the correct negative of 'We planted beans'? (1 mark)
   A. We not planted beans.
   B. We didn't planted beans.
   C. We don't planted beans.
   D. We didn't plant beans.

15. What is hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. A school subject only
   B. Playing with friends
   C. A type of exercise
   D. Keeping yourself and things clean to stay healthy

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Plan a composition called 'My School Compound' by saying what goes into each of three paragraphs. (3 marks)

17. Copy in neat print: 'Please listen carefully.' Circle the silent letter. (2 marks)

18. List two facts from the story about how HIV cannot spread. (2 marks)

19. Write a short headline and two sentences for a news story about your school. (3 marks)

20. Fill in this form line with your own details in block letters: Name, Grade, School. (Write an example.) (3 marks)

21. Arrange in order: (a) Then she paid. (b) Grace entered the shop. (c) Finally, she went home. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — won't
   'Will not' becomes 'won't'.

2. C — a small round red ball
   The order is size, shape, colour.

3. A — A story that tells what happened in order
   A narrative tells events in order.

4. A — I went to the market I bought fish we went home.
   Three ideas are run together without full stops.

5. C — use clues and think
   Inference means working out the answer from clues.

6. B — bite
   Bite has /aɪ/.

7. C — television
   'Television' has /ʒ/. 'Jug' and 'bridge' have /ʤ/.

8. B — soap
   'Soap' has /əʊ/.

9. C — Read the instructions
   Instructions tell you how to fill in the form.

10. A — yellow
   'Yellow' begins with /j/, the y sound. 'Jam' and 'giant' begin with /ʤ/.

11. C — Fill it with a parent or teacher
   A trusted adult can help you keep your details safe.

12. C — the first help given to a person who is hurt or ill
   First aid is given before a doctor takes over.

13. D — mango
   We can count mangoes.

14. D — We didn't plant beans.
   After didn't, use the base form plant.

15. D — Keeping yourself and things clean to stay healthy
   Hygiene protects us from germs.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Paragraph 1: what the compound is and where. Paragraph 2: details such as trees, playground, buildings. Paragraph 3: how I feel about it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each paragraph.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Please listen carefully. (silent t in listen)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for neat copying and 1 mark for identifying t.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: It cannot spread by playing, shaking hands, sharing a plate or hugging.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct fact.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Headline: Pupils Win Football Match. The school team won 2 to 1 on Friday. The pupils were happy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a headline and 1 for each sentence.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Name: AMINA NJOROGE; Grade: 4; School: SUNRISE PRIMARY SCHOOL (any correct example).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each line in block letters.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: b, a, c
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for b first and 1 mark for a then c.
